name: Service ops
description: Inspect, restart and follow a service, on systemd, OpenRC or plain SysV alike.
author: voltius

snippets.name: Inspect a service
snippets.description: Status plus the last log lines, from whichever service manager and log source this host has.

steps.content:
SVC="{{service}}"
LINES="{{lines:number:20}}"

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl status "$SVC" --no-pager
  echo
  echo "== last $LINES log lines =="
  LOG=$(journalctl -u "$SVC" -n "$LINES" --no-pager 2>&1)
  if [ -n "$LOG" ]; then echo "$LOG"; else echo "no journal entries for $SVC"; fi
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rc-service "$SVC" status
  echo
  echo "== last $LINES log lines =="
  tail -n "$LINES" "/var/log/$SVC.log" 2>/dev/null || echo "no /var/log/$SVC.log on this host"
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  service "$SVC" status
  echo
  echo "== last $LINES log lines =="
  tail -n "$LINES" "/var/log/$SVC.log" 2>/dev/null || echo "no /var/log/$SVC.log on this host"
else
  echo "no service manager found (systemctl, rc-service, service)"
fi

snippets.name: Restart a service
snippets.description: Shows the state, restarts, then shows it again so you can see whether it actually came back.

steps.content:
SVC="{{service}}"

# State before and after, either side of the restart — a restart you cannot see
# the result of is not worth running.
echo "== Before =="
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STATE=$(systemctl is-active "$SVC" 2>&1)
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STATE=$(rc-service "$SVC" status 2>&1)
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STATE=$(service "$SVC" status 2>&1)
else
  STATE=""
fi
if [ -n "$STATE" ]; then echo "$STATE"; else echo "unknown"; fi

echo
echo "== Restarting $SVC =="
if   command -v systemctl  >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo systemctl restart "$SVC"
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo rc-service "$SVC" restart
elif command -v service    >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo service "$SVC" restart
else echo "no service manager found"; fi

echo
echo "== After =="
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  systemctl status "$SVC" --no-pager 2>/dev/null | head -12
elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STATE=$(rc-service "$SVC" status 2>&1)
  if [ -n "$STATE" ]; then echo "$STATE"; else echo "unknown"; fi
elif command -v service >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STATE=$(service "$SVC" status 2>&1)
  if [ -n "$STATE" ]; then echo "$STATE"; else echo "unknown"; fi
else
  echo "unknown"
fi

snippets.name: Follow a service's logs
snippets.description: Live tail of a service's logs. Runs until you press Ctrl-C.

steps.content:
SVC="{{service}}"

# Runs until you stop it: press Ctrl-C in the terminal to stop following.
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  journalctl -u "$SVC" -f -n 50
elif [ -r "/var/log/$SVC.log" ]; then
  tail -f -n 50 "/var/log/$SVC.log"
elif [ -r /var/log/messages ]; then
  tail -f -n 50 /var/log/messages | grep -Fi "$SVC"
else
  echo "no log source found for $SVC (tried journalctl, /var/log/$SVC.log, /var/log/messages)"
fi
